# LaunchLoom progress update - 2026-11-16

## 2026-11-16T16:14Z Contrast glyph mask

- The pixel mask marked only visible glyph pixels, so text that matched its backdrop disappeared from the mask and false-passed. Four contrast contracts failed.
- The resolver now draws the text into an off-screen canvas with the computed font and line boxes, including input values, and unions that contrast-independent glyph shape with the visible-glyph mask. Borders, accent rules, and shadows outside the glyphs stay excluded.
- Corrected two stale expectations: the translucent-shadow input is readable because its glyphs end before the plate; the gradient case still fails at 1.84, below the 4.5 gate.
- Validation: 86/86 rendered contrast tests and 83/83 other contrast suites.

## 2026-11-16T15:17Z Approval merge conflicts

- Approving a preview whose `review/initial` branch was based on an older main failed with a raw GitHub 405: `Pull Request has merge conflicts`.
- Fresh previews now always clone the client's current `main` and create `review/initial` from it, instead of reusing the older review branch. This keeps the preview mergeable after a publication or client revision.
- The approval endpoint maps GitHub 405/409 merge conflicts to a 409 `preview_conflict` with an actionable "Generate a fresh preview" message, so the banner no longer shows a raw API error.
- Validation: `worker/test/approval.test.ts` 14/14, `tests/generation-workflow-foundation.test.ts` 19/19.
